_instructions: This template defines the metadata structure for saved game configuration profiles.
Remove all _instructions and _comment fields when inspecting or editing.
game: REQUIRED — exact display name of the game, e.g. 'Cyberpunk 2077'

target_display.refresh_rate: OPTIONAL — target refresh rate in Hz, e.g. 240, 60

optimisation_goal: REQUIRED — one of: performance | balanced | quality
fps_floor: OPTIONAL — integer FPS target (balanced goal only)
description: OPTIONAL — summary of profile purpose and visual/latency targets

files.relative_path: REQUIRED — config filename stored in profile directory
files.sha256: REQUIRED — SHA256 checksum of the config file
